attributes.name: Lucrecia
attributes.powers:
Lucrecia is immune to the Mental trait.

Before the encounter, Lucrecia deals 1d4-1 Force damage to a character of your choice at this location.

Any character dealt damage by Lucrecia also buries 1 random card from his discard pile.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
